items.item_text: Licensed to practice veterinary medicine in California by hire date.
Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree or equivalent.
Experience in a busy veterinary clinic or academic institution practicing high-quality medicine.
Two or more years of small animal practice experience.
Teaching experience with veterinary students and/or house officers.

Primarily to receive, treat and stabilize canine and feline emergency patients in collaboration with veterinary specialists and house officers. In addition, this role will assist in the teaching and professional training and development of veterinary student externs and house officers while providing small animal emergency veterinary care.
Completion of a small animal rotating or emergency medicine internship
Communication skills and ability to work well with others in a collegial and professional team atmosphere.
